sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Styled multi-line text box
sections.what: Draws a text area with default borders, padding, focus ring and disabled look, plus any extra styling the caller adds.
sections.why: Likely reason: shared styling for form text entry. Otherwise reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Caller class names are added last, so a caller can override the defaults.

summary: A styled box for typing several lines of text, used for longer text entry in forms.
purpose: Lets a user enter longer text with the same look as other form fields.
why: Likely reason: a shared input so all long-text boxes look and behave alike. Otherwise reason not stated in the code.
how: Takes all standard text area settings from the caller, merges in the default styling, and passes the ref to the real text area element.
inputs: Standard text area properties such as value, onChange, placeholder, rows and disabled, plus an optional className and a ref.
outputs: A text area element on screen.
risks: Minimal. Text handling belongs to the caller.
debug: If typing does not work, check the value and onChange pairing in the calling screen. If the look is off, check the className the caller passes.
